value.rationale: The classification supplies full natural integral equivariant H1 for every connected graph and a closed infinite two-parameter family of target-dihedral quotient rational Betti numbers. This distinguishes zero winding circles killed by reflection from positive winding circles that survive in a quotient, an invariant not encoded in existing component homotopy types or non-equivariant Betti tables. The quotient is a canonical symmetry reduction of graph colorings, not an arbitrary tiny parameter slice.
